hypothesis: Without guardrail measurement no change that moves posting or team start earlier can be judged safe
change: Instrument ledger-side corrections at 14 and 60 days (MET-0016, MET-0011) from the change feed of the two ledgers that have one, backfilled 90 days; unapproved sends (MET-0012) and week-1 permission downgrades (MET-0014) from existing product events; add an external-accountant field to the account record
expected_effect: Instrumentation live 2026-11-30; backfilled baselines for MET-0016, MET-0011, MET-0012 and MET-0014 by 2026-12-07; 4 weeks of live data by 2026-12-28; no guardrail for the third ledger until it offers a change feed
dependencies: Change feed access on two ledgers (EVD-2026-0022); CRM administrator

hypothesis: If unmatched rates are flagged instead of defaulted, and the accountant can review a pre-filled mapping with context and without a paid seat, first-attempt sync success rises and set-up stops pausing on the accountant
change: Flag unmatched tax rates at connection; a scoped, revocable no-seat review link for the accountant; an event trail for each open mapping question, visible to the admin
expected_effect: MET-0003 toward 80% on the two ledgers with a change feed, read on the monthly p-chart (before/after, so inferred at most); MET-0002 median 9 days or fewer; MET-0015 baseline; MET-0008 read in the next quarterly sample, no target
dependencies: Ships only to the two ledgers with a change feed, after the MET-0016 baseline (2026-12-07); review-link part needs Pricing and Packaging approval and the 8-accountant prototype

hypothesis: If admins can see the first posted invoice next to its ledger entry and mark it verified, they bring the team in sooner
change: First-invoice verification view with a verified state set by the admin, plus the MET-0006 confidence question; randomized by account, 50/50, among accounts with a first synced invoice, January to June 2027
expected_effect: MET-0005 difference detectable at about 15 points with about 170 accounts per arm; a 10-point effect needs about 390 per arm (stats.md); MET-0006 baseline in the control arm
dependencies: INI-0004 (MET-0012 baseline, due 2026-12-07); MET-0005 baseline cut before launch

hypothesis: If accounts can send invoices while mapping is unconfirmed, with posting held until confirmation, team start stops waiting on accounting set-up without raising ledger corrections
change: Harm-screening pilot: randomized by account 50/50 among new accounts under 10 seats on the two ledgers with a change feed, 8 weeks; posting held until mapping is confirmed; weekly sequential stop rule on MET-0016, confirmatory read of MET-0011 at 60 days
expected_effect: Detects only gross harm (MET-0016 roughly doubling); cannot show non-inferiority at 5 per 1,000 (needs about 790 accounts per arm) and cannot measure MET-0001 below about 27 points; any wider rollout is a recorded risk acceptance (stats.md)
dependencies: INI-0004 live with backfilled baseline and 4 weeks of live data; stop boundary and margin agreed
